response.overview: This critically acclaimed and highly controversial two-part special event serves as a fierce defense of free speech, censorship, and the boundaries of television comedy. When the animated show Family Guy announces it will broadcast an uncensored image of the Islamic prophet Muhammad, the entire town of South Park descends into a panic over potential terrorist retaliation, leading the citizens to literally bury their heads in the sand. As a desperate race to Hollywood breaks out, Cartman uses the national fear to weaponize corporate cowardice and get his rival cartoon canceled forever, while Kyle fights to defend artistic freedom at all costs.
response.tagline: Cartman vs. Family Guy: The ultimate animated showdown.
response.title: South Park: Cartoon Wars
